notes.title: [Crossing Frontier Additional Update Announcement]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/b1114f678410cecffccdfcb332ef31f099811b72.jpg[/img]

Hello, players!

Crossing Frontier will be undergoing an additional update this Friday (3/29), bringing you the long-awaited new character— Rai!

Rai is a vanguard-type tank shooter, always ready to charge into the fray, block enemy fire, and probe from a distance at the forefront. He can create advantageous spaces for his teammates, making him a reliable frontline character!

Following this update, we also plan to implement some major systematic updates and optimization projects. At the same time, we will continue to introduce more interesting and innovative content to enrich the game, so please stay tuned!

Let's get ready to welcome Rai and fight alongside this dependable battle captain!

notes.title: 【Arcade Mode LEVEL 4】
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/01aa4338154e8c5d431b7530b6a403c3c405eab2.png[/img]

Hello players! Today we’re introducing you a brand new level in Arcade Mode!

This time, players will venture into a secret base filled with Remanents! Dantalian leads his army of Remanents, beware of Uber Riesen and Behemoth he summons! And he's just the assistant to the level boss. At the end of the level, players will encounter the Sage of Conquest - Karmel! Dodge her magic bullets and blocks from all directions and defeat Karmel to claim victory!

notes.title: 【Barfyze - Chapter 1: Fantasy, Ideal, and Reality】
notes.content:
With the beginning of the Lunar New Year special sale, next, let’s see the brand new PVE chapter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/7895b27e695b5efb9b65fc140ff415fcb03f1bab.jpg[/img]
<Story Mode: Barfyze - Chapter 1: Fantasy, Ideal, and Reality>
Barfyze receives news of magical creatures appearing in a certain territory. In order to prevent these magical creatures from becoming the fuse of a new conflict, Freyja and Eruda begin their investigation...

In addition to experiencing the new chapter, don't forget you can also visit the shop for Lunar New Year new products!

notes.title: 【Lunar New Year Sale Begins!】
notes.content:
Hello, players! The Lunar New Year is almost here, and we wish everyone a happy New Year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/f80e34eecc9b5406a69fd77a39f59460a3f02156.jpg[/img]
<New skin: Herrina - Crimson Demon>
The frenzy has begun, with the moon stained in crimson. We’re running out of time!
When the peace guarded by Barfyze is challenged, even if she turns into a demon, Captain Herrina is willing to pay any price to pave the way to peace! Introducing Captain Herrina's new skin -Crimson Demon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/861861b48c9d22c664b8985e5a29d5c924221bc2.jpg[/img]
<Lunar New Year Sale>
What's Lunar New Year without everything new? Not only new appearances, but also new accessories! Want a muscular beckoning cat to help you attract wealth and prosperity? Seeing lion dances and dragon dances on the streets, do you also want to showcase your superb lion dance and dragon dance skills on the battlefield against teammates and opponents? Feeling super wealthy and suddenly wanting to become everyone's God of Wealth? None of these are problems~ Hurry to the shop and check them out!

Of course, the Lunar New Year update isn't just about new products! PVE new chapters and levels are also updated! Are you all excited? See you in the game!

notes.title: Game Update (2024/01/18) - Hotfix
notes.content:
※ System:
Fixed the issue in the mode selection queue where the title and description wouldn't change with the mode.

※ Arcade Mode:
Fixed the issue in the "Enchanting Wild" third level where killing a "Innocent Isuna" on multiplayer difficulty would trigger victory.
Adjusted the "Enchanting Wild" third level, closing the prompt message when the money bag is destroyed.
Fixed the issue of shop where the prompt window for insufficient mana crystals wouldn't close after closing the page.
Fixed the issue of spawned minions being invulnerable.

※ Art, UI, Text, Sound Updates:
Corrected the timing errors for some character respawn voice lines.
Updated the images and corresponding icons for mode selection.
Updated the background music for the "Fantasy Land" in Arcade mode.

※ Gameplay Adjustments:
§ Characters:
Quémeau:
Fixed the issue where respawn voice lines weren't playing.

Herrina:
Fixed the issue with the talent "Maw of the Beast" where grabbing an enemy wouldn't allow input for Arc Slash.

notes.title: Game Update 2024/01/17_10:00 ~19:00 (GMT+8)
notes.content:
※System:
1. Adjusted the setting option: If the player's screen refresh rate exceeds 144Hz, the second-to-last option will now match the player's screen maximum refresh rate.
2. Removed the "Daily Rewards Event" page.
3. Removed the "Official Launch Celebration Events" page.

※Game Modes Related:
1. Fixed the issue where the airdrop effect name and description wouldn't display when claiming the airdrop effect.
2. Fixed the issues in Arcade Mode; now, if a player is already in the preparation area upon completing the level, there is no need to re-enter.
3. Fixed Pig Lanterns; now players can attack to stop Pig Lanterns’ attacks when they cast flame and freeze magic.
4. Added visual effects for Pig Lanterns’ charge attack.
5. Fixed an issue with the volume being too loud when Ravenous Soul - Mare casts certain skills.
6. Fixed the issue where Eins could pass through some impassable walls in Arcade Mode.
7. Fixed the abnormal display issue with the Tab scoreboard in Arcade Mode.
8. Fixed an issue in Arcade Mode where some basic minions would still chase Eins while she is invisible.
9. Fixed the issue where Insane AI would sometimes continuously move towards walls.
10. Temporarily disabled two "Deathmatch Mode(Ace)" modes.
11. Updated the visual effects for Pig Lanterns' freeze magic.

※Art, UI, Text, Sound Updates:
1. Fixed an issue in the settings menu where displaying more than 5 single-item options caused abnormal behavior.
2. Adjusted the UX for selecting stages in PVE interface; the selected stage now maintains an enlarged effect.
3. Fixed an issue in Arcade Mode rooms where some levels would not display their names.
4. Adjusted the display name text in Arcade Mode rooms: Level Number → Level Name.
5. Adjusted the UX for changing levels in Arcade Mode rooms; the selected level now maintains an enlarged effect.

※Gameplay Adjustments:

Characters:
Martin:
1. Fixed the issue in Arcade Mode where Martin could pull the enemy Hillard over walls.

Belle:
1. Fixed the issue where the skill "Gatling Gun" icon wouldn't properly gray out when lacking mana.

notes.title: 【Arcade Mode Level 3: Enchanted Wild】
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/9b23466f5a8b2032a3b4e5900779880bedd8e05a.jpg[/img]
Hello players!

Routine maintenance completed! This update we have new content: Level 03 in the Adventure Mode: Enchanted Wild!

This time, players will journey to the kingdom of Arniah, where Ming and Rai reside, embarking on a brand-new adventure. Along the way, you'll encounter many magical creatures and cunning bandits. At the final part, challenge the new boss, "Ravenous Soul" Mare!

notes.title: Game Update 2024/01/10_10:00 ~ 19:00 (GMT+8)
notes.content:
Store Updates:
Adjusted the gold price for Beros and Hechra: 18000→12000

System:
1. New Mail System: In the future, any official rewards will be sent as mail to your mailbox.
2. Altered the lobby's preview character UX; pressing ESC while on the character selection interface will now prioritize closing that interface rather than opening the settings menu.
3. Adjusted the timing of character voice playback in the lobby's character preview; voices will not play while previewing characters.
4. Adjusted lobby's character voice preview: new voiceovers will not play if there's an ongoing voiceover.
5. Closed the page of Streamer Challenge event.
6. Added an option in the settings menu for the maximum frames per second in the lobby and in-game.
7. Added achievements and rewards for completing different difficulty levels in Arcade Mode.

Gameplay Related:
1. Fixed the issue in the Arcade Mode's "Fantasy Land" where summoned beasts had a chance of dying instantly.
2. Fixed the problem where bosses in the Arcade Mode would die instantly in high difficulty or multiplayer play.
3. Fixed the issue in the Arcade Mode's resting area (where the inventory was empty when opening the shop).
4. Added a new level, "Enchanted Wild" to Arcade Mode.

Art, UI, Text, Sound Updates:
1. Adjusted the layout and scroll bar size in the chapter selection interface.
2. Standardized the positions for enabling and disabling options in the settings menu; the enable option is now fixed on the right side.

Gameplay Adjustments:
General:
Added sidestep Up/Down: You can now spend 2 units of stamina to use sidestep up or down.

Hillard:
Reduced Shield Bash mana cost: 380→360.
Decreased Vortex mana cost: 440→400.
Lowered Vortex damage: 50→35.

notes.title: 【Ming and Rai - New Year's Visit】
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/19d8d44bf745ef7013b7233310675363b4f339da.jpg[/img]

Happy New Year to all players! Did everyone get enough sleep on New Year's Day? 

After the lively New Year's Eve, the next day is surely a day for sleeping in till noon. However, in the mysterious eastern country, Arniah, Ming and Rai have different plans🤔 

As the first light of the New Year appears, the heiress of the Seafarer's Guild, Ming, and her close attendant, Rai, traditionally set out on their respectful journey to the shrine.

With the shrine illuminated by the morning sun, Ming focuses earnestly on her prayers. She prays for the prosperity of the country, and Seafarer's Guild, and hopes to bring greater welfare to the people of the nation. Meanwhile, Rei stands guard silently by Ming's side, offering silent prayers for divine protection, wishing for Ming and Seafarer's Guild to be free from any calamity. Both hope to enjoy success and peace in this new year full of unknown opportunities. In the shrine, they represent not only worshippers but also the future and hope of the Seafarer's Guild.

Beacon of Gamers Studio wishes all players a Happy New Year! In this upcoming year filled with various adventures, we are ready to bring you more exciting game content. Wishing everyone a fun time ahead!

notes.title: 【Update Schedule】
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/72efb096b3fa9f5dd6f9cceb84fca3e3528161d5.jpg[/img]
Hello players! It's another night perfect for some intense brawls! 👊

Tonight, we're here to share the upcoming updates for Crossing Frontiers with all of you.

December-January
〈Story Mode: Chapter of Barphyze〉
Over the next couple of months, Crossing Frontiers will unveil a brand-new chapter in the story mode — the first Chapter of Barphyze. Join Freya, Eluda's adventure!

〈New Character: Dantalian〉
As the assistant to the great mage Karmel, Dantalian showcases incredible abilities! What exactly these abilities are? Well, we'll leave that as a little surprise for now. 😆

February-March
〈Story Mode: Journey of Cultivation〉
In the months ahead, the first chapter of the Journey of Cultivation, narrating the escapades of Isuna and Mare, will take you on an adventurous journey filled with delightful moments!

〈New Character: Rai〉
Rai — many players may have already witnessed his remarkable presence! As for where exactly? Let's test the sharpness of your wit! 🧐

Are these upcoming updates getting everyone excited? Even better things are awaiting ahead! 😆 Crossing Frontiers is all set to introduce numerous new PVP modes and more levels for the adventure mode. Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: 【Christmas Surprise】
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731778/c88547cfdefd3c80f0949db541dea359623f4634.jpg[/img]

Hello, players! Christmas has arrived! Merry Christmas! 🎄

This year, as a special surprise for Christmas, we've secretly placed Santa hats 🎅 in everyone's inventory. Wear them and get into the spirit of both brawling and Christmas!

Our Uncle Thunder, Hechra, also brought a special gift 🎁 for Beros this Christmas! 

Dressed as Santa Claus, he personally surprised Beros with an adorable toy puppy🐶! The joyous expression on Beros' face as she embraces this precious gift makes Hechra laugh with happiness, and the whole scene is filled with warmth! Can you feel the heartwarming atmosphere😊?
 
Hope everyone cherishes the warmth and happiness of this special day and, like Hechra, spread your love and kindness to those dear to you! 💕

Lastly, Beacon of Gamers Studio wishes everyone a joyous Christmas! 🎅🎄✨
